Actual air temperature and measured wind speed were not provided.

approval.evidence: User approved all five casual rain editorials and requested individual product images plus English, German and Korean HOW TO WEAR copy.

mappingNote: Mapped in app b118 under the street tab (user decision 2026-10-22); asset style stays casual.

deck.en: An olive hood, crimson knit and a scarf pulled close.
deck.de: Olivgrüne Kapuze, tiefroter Strick und ein eng gewickelter Schal.
deck.ko: 올리브 후드 속 크림슨 니트, 목에는 포근한 차콜 머플러.

intro.en: Let the olive puffer provide the volume and keep the crimson knit as a small warm flash of color. Wrap the charcoal scarf close, lift the hood, and keep the crossbody bag compact. Dark indigo jeans, warm black socks and flat lace-up boots complete the lower half proposed in the styling brief.
intro.de: Die olivgrüne Steppjacke bringt Volumen, der tiefrote Pullover setzt einen kleinen warmen Farbakzent. Wickle den anthrazitfarbenen Schal eng, setze die Kapuze auf und halte die Crossbody kompakt. Dunkle Indigojeans, warme schwarze Socken und flache Schnürboots ergänzen den im Styling vorgesehenen unteren Teil.
intro.ko: 올리브 푸퍼로 볼륨을 만들고 크림슨 니트는 작지만 따뜻한 컬러 포인트로 보여 주세요. 차콜 머플러를 목 가까이 두르고 후드를 올린 뒤, 작은 크로스보디 백으로 정리합니다. 하의는 스타일링 기획에 맞춰 다크 인디고 진과 블랙 보온 양말, 플랫 레이스업 부츠를 연결해 주세요.

tip.en: Keep the hood and scarf close without covering the crimson color at the neckline completely.
tip.de: Kapuze und Schal liegen nah an, ein wenig Rot darf am Ausschnitt sichtbar bleiben.
tip.ko: 후드와 머플러를 가까이 여미되 목 아래 붉은 니트는 조금 남겨 주세요.

note.en: Layer over a thick knit with room to move; choose verified rain protection for actual use.
note.de: Über dickem Strick mit Bewegungsfreiheit tragen; für den Alltag ausgewiesenen Regenschutz wählen.
